basics.name: Mitchell Ray
basics.label: Full Stack Software Engineer
basics.summary: Full stack software engineer with 6+ years building performant web applications end to end. Comfortable owning features from schema to pixel, with a focus on developer experience, observability, and shipping small increments often.

work.name: Cloud Systems
highlights: Led migration of a monolith's billing path to an event-driven service, cutting p95 latency by 42%.
Built an internal feature-flag SDK adopted by 14 teams, removing the need for bespoke release tooling.
Mentored 4 engineers and introduced a weekly design-review ritual that reduced rework.

work.name: Northwind Labs
highlights: Shipped a customer analytics dashboard used daily by 3,000+ accounts.
Reduced CI time from 22 to 7 minutes by parallelizing the test matrix and caching builds.

projects.name: ResumeTitan
highlights: Built an AI-driven resume assistant using a MERN stack integrated with Google Gemini to generate personalized resume content and interview preparation.
Deployed to production on Fly.io with automated CI/CD via GitHub Actions.
Acquired 200+ users through word-of-mouth, free resume workshops, and partnerships with career advisors and government agencies (NC Works).

awards.title: Engineering Excellence Award
awards.summary: Recognized for leading the billing migration.

volunteer.summary: Run monthly resume workshops and 1:1 mock interviews for career changers.
